description: Main front-end source code for a Flutter-based dating app's filters page, including theme setup, filter state management, UI layout, and query parameter generation.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget setting the Ocean Professional theme and home page.

classes.name: CanonicalOption
classes.description: Represents a user-facing label and machine key for filter options.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Holds user's filter selections and builds URL query parameters.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enumeration of hair colors used for filtering.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Main page widget for filter controls with styled UI and state management.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Creates color scheme based on brightness for Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Generates ThemeData using the specified color scheme and styles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp with theme and initial home widget.

methods.name: _applyFilters
methods.description: Builds query parameters from current filter state and shows a confirmation snackbar.

methods.name: _buildDropdownItems
methods.description: Creates dropdown menu items with a 'Not specified' placeholder.
